thread:
Maya: heads up — customer ACME reported a surprise token spike on last invoice, ~2.4k tokens billed for a single request but their SDK estimate was ~1.1k. invoice id inv_0acme_2026-03. Can someone triage? :thinking:

James (billing): Thanks Maya. Do we have the original request payload + API response headers / request id? need to repro token count on server side.

Maya: attaching the repro snippet they used and the SDK log they sent. they used our JS SDK v2.0.2 and also tried a raw curl.

Maya: ```
# curl repro (redacted keys)
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-large","messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"Summarize the following long doc..."}],"max_tokens":1024}'
```

Maya: raw response headers included:
```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Request-Id: rq_0acme_9981
X-Usage-Tokens: 2380
Content-Type: application/json
```

Maya: SDK log (client-side token estimate): "token_estimate: 1184"

Eli (sdk): quick note — the SDK uses a client-side tokenizer and by default excludes certain internal/system tool messages from its estimate. can you paste the exact JSON payload sent (including any metadata fields, tools, or function calls)?

Maya: customer says they enabled a plugin that does a lookup and returns a big JSON snippet via a tool call. they pasted only their user/system message earlier, not the tool response (they thought tool responses aren't billed).

support-jen: reminder: tool outputs and injected assistant/system messages are billed. also streaming framing + function-edge metadata can add tokens. we've had a couple of customers assume tool outputs were free.

James (billing): also check for platform-injected safety/system prompts — sometimes our private deployments inject a short assistant system for telemetry/consent which the SDK doesn't simulate. sre-ops can you check if that request had any server-side injections? rq_0acme_9981

sre-ops: looked up rq_0acme_9981 — found a server-side policy that appended a 2-line assistant prompt for lineage tracking (internal id info). that added ~120 tokens once tokenized (because of verbosity + JSON-like metadata). also the tool call returned a 900-token JSON blob that the model echoed back in the completion. combined with the user's long input that explains the ~2.38k header.

Eli (sdk): ok that explains parity gap. SDK v2.0.2 purposely omits tool outputs and server-injected system messages from the estimate. we added an opt-in `include_server_tokens` flag in v2.1.4 that will request a token breakdown header for exact parity: `X-Return-Token-Breakdown: true`. recommend upgrading SDK or run raw curl with header.

James (billing): for immediate customer response: explain that invoice is correct given server-side injected system prompt + tool output + completion echo. offer a one-time billing credit if customer was unaware of the plugin returning large payloads.

Maya: replied to customer with a short summary and asked if they want us to redact the tool output or enable token-limits on plugin responses. customer opted to cap tool responses.

billing-bot: Automated note: Created billing ticket BT-4629 for inv_0acme_2026-03, status: pending review. :memo:

Eli (sdk): repro commands to get exact token breakdown (useful for future cases):
```
# get exact server token breakdown header
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-Return-Token-Breakdown: true" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-large","messages":[...]}'

# or upgrade SDK to v2.1.4 and call: client.generate({..., includeServerTokens: true})
```

support-jen: adding knowledgebase note: "SDK estimates may differ from billed tokens when: tool outputs are large, server injects system/assistant messages, or streaming/frame overhead occurs. Use X-Return-Token-Breakdown to reconcile."

Maya: marking as resolved with notes to customer and KB link. thanks all :tada:
